title: Retail AC client DAT contract
purpose: Authoritative invariants for retail-format client_*.dat folders used by ACME as editor/export target. Legacy import profiles are deltas on this base.

invariants: Exactly one B-tree catalog entry per file ID
Leaf branch slots must not contain 0xCDCDCDCD when branch[0] would imply traversal
Logical header file size must cover all catalog payload offsets (no past-EOF reads)
Converted exports use native no-op transaction journal, not retail seed replay journal

Overlay writes replace existing IDs in place via TryWriteFile/TryWriteFileBytes; never Tree.TryDelete before a write (delete-before-write corrupts B-tree ordering; TryDelete is reserved for genuine removals/dedupe repair)

portal_shell_retail_bytes.description: Must remain retail-compatible bytes when present; editor overlay must not stamp retail metadata onto non-retail payloads

exceptions.0x0E000002: CharGen table: retail heritage/setup shell; starting areas may be customized in import profiles

cell_world.landblock: LandBlock at landblock id (upper 16 bits of cell)
cell_world.env_cell: EnvCell at full cell id; outdoor spawns often reference LBI not EnvCell

client_load_phases.description: Open four client_*.dat files; validate header magic and load B-tree
Walk portal catalog; resolve client metadata enum maps and spell tables via GetByEnum
invariants: retail portal btree root preserved when overlaying content (0x232D400 on reference seed)

client_load_phases.description: Load LayoutDesc and StringTable from client_local_English.dat
Char select UI; StringTable resolution uses client cache type 37
CharGen 0x0E000002 heritage groups resolve Setup and EnvironmentSetup chains in portal
required_readable: each heritage SetupId and EnvironmentSetupId in portal
expanded render chain from CharGen shell collector

client_load_phases.description: Spawn from character position; load cell landblock/LBI/EnvCell and terrain via Region
required_in_cell_dat: EnvCell or outdoor cell resolution for indoor spawns

hard_fail_conditions: missing any of four retail files
B-tree read compatibility issues on portal/cell/local
CharGen not readable when export uses retail CharGen shell

transform_profiles.note: Import/conversion profiles (e.g. Dark Majesty) must declare deltas against this spec

supported_modes.FullDm: Everything DM (world, art, textures, CharGen, appearance tables) + DM UI replacing retail UI (DM 0x31/EXE wording + layout shapes on retail LayoutDesc skeleton; shared login/connect shell art stays retail bytes)
supported_modes.HalfDm: DM world/textures/objs/setups/cells; retail UI, CharGen, appearance and spell/skill/vital tables
